text: SOE's Dutch section put eight random letters before and after every message. Padding at the start moves the known words along the copper; padding at the end moves nothing.

Every start run 0-12, a repeating key or one that slides by any step after every letter or every pass, lengths 1-52, on the sculpture's tables, K4 against ten scrambled copies and two planted padded messages.
Nothing fits below length 26 on K4 or on any copy, whatever the start run; the planted messages are found at their own lengths. F2.4 closed.
